name: Catch-Lookout Spring (station 6, Oasis 5 of Route B; PLAN.md section 6): Manzar al-Masid on a faulted titanium-basalt ledge at 3,690 m (1.01 atm), Route B's last oasis before the descent to Stair: a 70 C alkaline-chloride spring feeding stepped travertine soaking basins down the bench toward the scarp's lip, wind-flagged dwarf agate-pine krummholz on the warm margins, sedge and cushions, the lookout cairn on the lip with the Catch's pale floor spread below, and Route B going down the scarp's breach
